description: Defines the RuntimeManagerHandler class and its nested RuntimeManagerNotification class, which manage runtime lifecycle events and interactions with the IRuntimeManager interface within the WPEFramework plugin architecture.

classes.name: RuntimeManagerHandler
classes.description: Manages runtime lifecycle events, initialization, and communication with the runtime manager interface within the plugin.

classes.name: RuntimeManagerNotification
classes.description: Implements the IRuntimeManager::INotification interface to handle runtime events such as start, terminate, failure, and state changes.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the runtime manager with the provided service and event handler.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Starts a runtime application with specified parameters.

methods.name: kill
methods.description: Kills the runtime application identified by appInstanceId.

methods.name: wake
methods.description: Wakes the runtime application and sets its state.

methods.name: getRuntimeStats
methods.description: Retrieves runtime statistics for the specified application.
